exposure_definition: r6 diagnosis_text(include_summary=True) versus diagnosis_text(include_summary=False), multiset difference of selected lines. added_selected_summary_text counts reports with at least one added selected summary line; added_selected_summary_clauses counts sentence clauses in those added lines. Selection includes explicit subtype fields under the r6 parser. Diagnosis/summary presence uses r6 sections. These counts do not adjudicate clinical accuracy.
